result.summary: The pedestrian environment is currently compromised by extensive construction activity, with sidewalks on both sides narrowed and enclosed by fencing. The lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals in this high-activity institutional area creates a fragmented and potentially hazardous walking environment.

hazards.name: Construction Fencing Obstruction
hazards.description: Green construction fencing and orange barriers significantly narrow the pedestrian walkway and create visual blind spots for both drivers and walkers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the sidewalks

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements in a narrowed roadway.

interventions.title: Temporary High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install temporary zebra-style crosswalks to provide clear, designated crossing points during the construction phase.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding and Detour Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear signage to guide pedestrians through the construction zone and indicate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove obstructions near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is heavily disrupted by an active construction site, with barriers and fencing obstructing the primary sidewalk. While pedestrian signals and crossing signs are present, the walkway is cluttered with sandbags and temporary signage, creating tripping hazards and requiring detours.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Water-filled orange barriers and green fencing block the primary sidewalk path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center of the image

hazards.name: Tripping Hazards
hazards.description: Sandbags and temporary sign bases are placed directly on the pedestrian walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Closure
hazards.description: Signs indicate the sidewalk is closed, forcing pedestrians to find alternative routes that may not be protected.

interventions.title: Temporary Protected Walkway
interventions.description: Provide a physically protected and ADA-compliant bypass for pedestrians around the construction zone.

interventions.title: Improved Detour Signage
interventions.description: Install clear directional signage at decision points to guide pedestrians safely around the closure.

interventions.title: Hazard Removal
interventions.description: Relocate sandbags and temporary sign bases to keep the pedestrian clear zone free of tripping hazards.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban pedestrian environment with a wide sidewalk and a marked zebra crosswalk. Pedestrian safety is supported by curb ramps with tactile paving, though visibility is partially obstructed by parked vehicles and construction equipment on the right side of the road.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and construction equipment on the right side of the street may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks active controls like signals or stop signs, relying on driver compliance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and make pedestrians more visible.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked continental crosswalk in front of an institutional building, currently managed by a security guard. Pedestrian safety is significantly compromised by a vehicle stopped directly within the crosswalk and adjacent construction barriers that may limit walkway space and visibility.

hazards.name: Vehicle blocking crosswalk
hazards.description: A blue sedan is stopped entirely within the marked crosswalk, forcing pedestrians to deviate from the protected path into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, occupying the crosswalk area

hazards.name: Construction barriers
hazards.description: Orange barriers and fencing on the right side of the image obstruct the sidewalk and may create blind spots for pedestrians entering the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street adjacent to the building

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to physically prevent vehicles from stopping in the crosswalk and to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement and enforce strict 'No Stopping' zones near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Install permanent pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers of the crossing location, especially during periods when a guard is not present.
